historical_proof: Preserve all exhaustive shadows, synthetic discriminants, journals, historical tests and prior receipts. Age alone never justifies deleting proof.

historical-full.purpose: Exhaustive historical aggregate for a new certification epoch. Plain invocation remains exhaustive.

active.purpose: Routine targeted regression between FULL epochs; never equivalent to certification of every archived proof.

full_epoch_triggers: Common native bridge transaction semantics change
Shared proof/capture schema changes that can alter interpretation
Material change to exact reconstruction mechanism
Known historical certificate dependency modified without narrower proof
Before a major refactor or release milestone
certificate_limit: A certified commit is historical evidence, not an automatic certificate for arbitrary descendant code. No dependency-hash invalidation engine is implemented in Phase 1.
